claims.exact_statement: For the two CTMC transient generators T_A=[[-3,1],[0,-1]], r_A=(2,1)^T, alpha_A=(1,0), and T_B=[[-11/4,3/4],[7/12,-5/4]], r_B=(2,2/3)^T, alpha_B=(1,0), both models are valid two-phase absorbing CTMCs with the same initial state. With S=[[1,0],[1/4,3/4]], T_B=S^-1 T_A S, alpha_B=alpha_A S, r_B=S^-1 r_A. Therefore they induce exactly the same activation-time density (3/2)e^(-3t)+(1/2)e^(-t) for all t>=0 and the same activation-before-independent-Exp(delta)-off probability for every delta>=0, although A is one-way sequential and B contains a positive reverse transition.
assumptions: Two transient states and one absorbing activation state.
Only activation time, activation/no-activation under an independent ligand-off clock, or functions of those observations are measured.
Initial state is the known first transient state in both models.
claims.status: internally reconstructed exact construction; general similarity mechanism is established phase-type prior art
claims.novelty_boundary: Phase-type representation nonuniqueness is established. No novelty claim is made for the similarity construction. Direct TCR architecture resolution is a high-ceiling experimental target, but current priority is UNKNOWN.
claims.costs: Exact FPT observation cannot distinguish the pair even with infinite precision and unlimited samples. A model-specific added readout of transient phase 2 has maximal predicted probability gap 1/(12 sqrt(3)) at t=(log 3)/2 in the chosen rate units. With known rates and ideal independent binary reads, a midpoint classifier needs n>=2589 independent receptor episodes for a one-sided Hoeffding error bound 0.05. Real receptor episodes, state-specific reporter calibration, pMHC dwell-time control, imaging/photophysics, dropout, and biological replication are unmeasured; biological sample count and monetary cost are UNKNOWN.
claims.falsifier: A failure of the displayed similarity identities, CTMC rate nonnegativity/row-sum conditions, or equality of the activation-time laws would falsify this scoped construction. A phase-specific observation outside the predicted model value would reject the illustrative pair, not the general identifiability boundary.
claims.next_gate: Acquire same-receptor per-ITAM/ZAP70 intermediate-state and LAT-condensation trajectories under randomized dwell-time-controlled pMHC encounters and ITAM-count perturbations; compare parameter-matched sequential and multithread models on held-out ligand dwell times.

assumptions: The pinned source theorem is read with its exact definitions and oracle interface.
No separately constructed map from list matrices to admissible receptor generators/readouts is supplied.
claims.status: interface comparison; no theorem transfer claimed
claims.novelty_boundary: A scoped rejected transfer. Astra N25 is source-derived/unreviewed and is used only as an acquisition-cost warning, not as biological evidence.
claims.costs: Any proposed mapping would need to charge physical controls, matrix dimension, exact or noisy readout, calibration, and excitation. N25's exponential lower bound applies only to its specified noisy full-matrix oracle and excitation budget, not directly to cell assays.
claims.falsifier: An explicit, experimentally realizable map that preserves all inverse domains and produces robustly separated physical cell readouts from the released matrix probes would invalidate this rejection for that mapped subclass.
claims.next_gate: Do not spend further effort on the algebraic transfer absent such an explicit physical encoding; prioritize the direct molecular-observation experiment.
